scope: Analyst interpretation of exact human answers; never new human annotations or runtime policy features

rows.decision_use: Preserve the observed slight ON preference; consider timing of forward-looking relationship questions.
rows.interpretation_limit: The reply lacks target historical facts; information-mediated advantage is not established. Do not infer a universal no-question rule.

rows.decision_use: Allow multiple reasonable support strategies and equivalent judgments.
rows.interpretation_limit: A tie is an ordinal judgment, not a measured exact quality delta.

rows.decision_use: Use as a counterexample to rewarding accurate target-fact adoption automatically.
rows.interpretation_limit: This case now adopts mutual breaks but is tied; no assertion that all such history is worthless.

rows.decision_use: Use as a counterexample to automatic rewards for personalized background.
rows.interpretation_limit: No generalization to all personalized responses or hidden recipient preferences.

rows.decision_use: Retain as one of two prespecified OFF comparisons; both responses acceptable.
rows.interpretation_limit: Not evidence of global G superiority or a separate independent participant.

rows.decision_use: Retain slight preference for new-G OFF and the researcher feeling-based reason.
rows.interpretation_limit: 85/95 remains illustrative wording; no numerical q/m, utility difference or material-benefit relabeling.

rows.decision_use: Retain slight ON preference and the explicit quality-tie/naturalness distinction in the reason.
rows.interpretation_limit: Naturalness can matter, but history content as its mechanism remains unresolved.

rows.decision_use: Allow comparable current-support responses when target constraints are not explicitly used.
rows.interpretation_limit: Non-use does not establish zero value if the financial constraint were used appropriately.
